name: dn-subtree-exact-match-valid
description: A leaf whose subject DN is exactly the permitted directoryName subtree (zero additional RDNs) must be accepted. RFC 5280 4.2.1.10 defines the subtree as including the constraint name itself: a chain of zero or more RDNs appended to the constraint is still inside the subtree.
notes: Implementations that require a strict subordinate (at least one extra RDN below the constraint) wrongly reject this.
